hero.headline: I build the architecture behind enterprise AI & digital transformation.
hero.description: I'm Shailesh Kumar — Senior Principal Enterprise Architect. I turn emerging technology, generative & agentic AI, and complex ERP/digital-core modernization into production-grade capability for global life sciences, healthcare and telecom enterprises. This is my journey, my thinking, and my work.
